title: Stream chunk sampling and PII-aware telemetry tags for streaming observability
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Add per-chunk sampling and PII-aware telemetry tags for streamed API responses so we can get high-fidelity latency / quality signals without logging sensitive content. This work will produce chunk-level telemetry events, ensure trace/span correlation across stream lifecycles (including tool/function call boundaries and structured-output chunks), and guarantee that logged telemetry contains no raw PII or unredacted user content.

Scope:
- Emit chunk-level telemetry events for every streamed chunk (or sampled subset) with tags: stream_id, chunk_index, chunk_type, model_variant, route, elapsed_ms, token_count, upstream_latency, and redaction_status.
- Attach OpenTelemetry spans that cover the stream lifecycle and optionally child spans per chunk when sampling is enabled.
- Implement an inline redaction step that removes or replaces PII in any chunk payload before it reaches logs/metrics pipelines. Redaction must run on the path used for telemetry (not only for persisted logs).
- Ensure compatibility with tool/function-calling and structured output modes: telemetry must record tool invocation boundaries and whether a chunk contains structured JSON or tool call tokens.

Out of scope:
- Full UI dashboards for chunk-level metrics (separate PM ticket).
- Long-term storage/retention policy changes for streaming logs (handled by infra).
tasks: Design event schema for chunk telemetry and OTel span mappings
Implement chunk telemetry emitter in runtime (C++/Rust path + Python/JS SDK hooks)
Add redaction library call in the streaming hot path with a lightweight policy (PII patterns + configurable allowlist)
Integrate sampling config: per-route sample rate, adaptive sampling for long streams
Propagate stream_id and chunk_index into tracing context and logs
Hook telemetry to existing metrics pipeline and add a feature flag for rollout
Add unit and integration tests (redaction, sampling, trace propagation)
Document schema and privacy guarantees in Confluence and developer docs
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits chunk telemetry events with required fields for 100% of streamed requests when feature flag enabled
OpenTelemetry traces include a parent span for the stream and sampled child spans for chunks when sampling>0
Redaction pipeline prevents common PII classes (emails, SSNs, credit card numbers) from appearing in telemetry payloads in tests
Telemetry tags indicate when a chunk included a tool/function call or structured JSON output
End-to-end latency overhead from telemetry + redaction is <= 5% p95 for our benchmark suite
PR with implementation passes code review and CI and a staging rollout confirms no increase in error rate
implementation_notes:
Approach: Add a lightweight ChunkTelemetry object (flat fields only) emitted to an internal telemetry buffer. Use the existing trace id as stream_id and a monotonic chunk_index assigned by the runtime. Redaction will run using a deterministic set of regex and heuristic rules; we will run redaction synchronously but optimized (precompiled regex, small state machine). Sampling will be configurable per-route with an adaptive controller that raises sample rate on errors or high latency.

Tracing: use OpenTelemetry semantic conventions. Create a stream parent span at stream start and attach attributes: route, model_variant, customer_tier. For sampled chunks, create child spans named "stream.chunk" with attribute chunk.index and chunk.type. Ensure spans are emitted at end-of-chunk flush to avoid blocking token generation.

Compatibility: For tool/function calling, mark chunk_type as "tool_boundary" when a chunk contains tool invocation start or end. For structured outputs (JSONL), set chunk_type to "json" and include a boolean attribute is_structured_output. The telemetry schema remains backward-compatible by keeping field names stable and by supporting an optional tags map encoded as key1=value1;key2=value2 when additional context is needed.

Performance considerations: avoid serializing full chunk contents into telemetry. Only include metadata and redaction_status. For sampled debug mode (off by default), allow inclusion of an obfuscated example token window.

Security: redaction must run before any logging/telemetry emission. We will add a security gating unit test and require security_review_required=true for this ticket.
